## English Version

### Quest Name
EntroFlow Humanoid Robot SDK Integration & Control App Intern (2 months)

### About Us
Entropy Force Field / Spatial Intelligence is building spatial intelligence agents and has been invited to exhibit at Nvidia BEYOND EXPO. We are developing EntroFlow, a standard integration and orchestration layer that allows robots from different vendors and models to be connected, monitored, and controlled through a unified interface.

### Scope of Work
We are looking for one intern for a 2-month engagement to help build out EntroFlow's humanoid robot integration ecosystem.

The main responsibilities include:

- Research and integrate SDKs, APIs, and communication protocols from different humanoid robot vendors
- Map each vendor's capabilities into the EntroFlow standard, including motion control, state reading, sensors, and task execution interfaces
- Build and maintain vendor adapters that connect EntroFlow with real robots or simulation environments
- Build an integrated control app that lets users connect to, monitor, and control multiple humanoid robots through one interface
- Write integration docs, examples, and test cases so future robot integrations can be added more easily

### Expected Deliverables
- Several mainstream humanoid robot SDKs mapped and connected to the EntroFlow standard
- A clear and extensible robot adapter layer
- A working integrated control app with unified connection, status display, and basic control features
- Integration documentation, sample code, and test records

### Ideal Candidate
- Comfortable with at least one of Python, TypeScript, or C++
- Experience with SDK/API integration, robotics software, ROS/ROS 2, network communication, or cross-platform app development
- Able to read English technical documentation and debug integration issues independently
- Interested in humanoid robots, embodied intelligence, and developer tools

Bonus points:

- Experience with real humanoid robots or simulation platforms
- Familiarity with ROS 2, WebSocket, gRPC, MQTT, or similar communication protocols
- Experience building desktop or cross-platform apps with Electron, Tauri, React Native, Flutter, or similar frameworks

### Work Arrangement
- Duration: 2 months
- Time commitment: 3–4 days per week
- Compensation: RMB ¥500 per day, paid based on actual working days
- Estimated total compensation: around RMB ¥12,000–16,000 over 8 weeks
- Work mode and start date are open to discussion

### Contact
Comment on this GitHub Issue or contact via Jojo as intermediary.

I can take this quest.

Approach:
- Review EntroFlow's current standard/interface expectations and identify the first vendor SDKs or simulator targets to integrate.
- Build a thin adapter layer that maps vendor capabilities into unified connection, state, sensor, motion-control, and task-execution interfaces.
- Implement the integrated control app workflow for connecting, monitoring, and basic control across multiple humanoid robot targets.
- Add integration notes, examples, and test records so future adapters can be added consistently.

Contact: comment here on GitHub.
Timeline: available for the 2-month engagement; exact start date and weekly schedule can be discussed.

你好，我想申请这个 EntroFlow 实习/协作机会，也可以先从 1-2 天的付费试工切片开始验证配合效率。

我更适合的切入点：

1. TypeScript/Python SDK/API 适配层：把不同厂商 SDK 能力整理成统一的 connection / state / sensor / motion / task 接口草案。
2. 控制 App 原型：先做一个 mock/simulator 驱动的连接、状态展示、基础控制 UI，方便后续接真机或仿真环境。
3. 接入文档和测试记录：把第一个厂商/模拟器的接入步骤、能力映射、限制和测试用例整理成可复用模板。

可先做一个小范围 paid trial：
- 1-2 天
- 交付一份适配层接口草案 + 一个 mock 控制 App / 示例连接流程 + 接入说明
- 只使用公开 SDK/文档或你们提供的 mock/simulator，不在公开 issue 中处理私密凭证或真机敏感信息

GitHub: https://github.com/Gavriel-lab
近期可参考的公开交付：
- https://github.com/Hyraze/collective-ai-tools/pull/222
- https://github.com/billybox1926-jpg/snipcontext/pull/49

如果这个方向合适，我可以先按你们指定的第一个机器人 SDK / simulator / mock target 做一个小切片，再决定是否进入更长周期。
